nodes.text:
2 cases of HMPV detected in Karnataka

A 3-month-old infant with bronchopneumonia was treated at a hospital in Bengaluru, and discharged.

An 8-month-old infant, also with bronchopneumonia, tested positive on Jan 3 and is currently recovering.
